findings.topic: Closed v23 proof and fixed map
findings.detail: The implementation briefing binds the exact frozen map/proof, eight source paths and raw hashes, 144 complete before/current item rows, and the 34 replacement / 110 same-ID partition.

The byte-exact v22 source receipt confirms compact JSON.stringify arrays without a trailing newline. The eight N07 paths are disjoint from v22’s ten N06 validation paths, allowing the unchanged v22 proof to run against the reconstructed private canonical view.
The design preserves all 13 existing literal descriptors, five private guard bodies, 14 immutable proof files, and the unchanged v22-to-v11 historical chain.

Restore questionLocations for the 34 replaced N07 IDs together with their prior question objects. The final implementation briefing incorporates this in-memory restoration, following the existing v13 predecessor pattern, so the private v22 canonical view remains internally coherent.

Restore an isolated exact v22 fixture before invoking the existing v22 test; preserve its original version/QSet/source/ID and negative assertions. Older fixtures should start from v23 then reuse existing predecessor restoration.

Focused v23 positives/negatives, affected historical-generation tests and actual migration verification establish producer behavior. Existing downstream app, candidate, admission and release checks remain separate.

limits: Design review only; actual source/proof/verifier/test changes require implementation review and executed checks.
